Biography
Dr. Lisa DiBernardi, DVM, is a board-certified veterinary radiation oncologist serving patients throughout Florida from AARADONC's dedicated center in Royal Palm Beach. With
more than 20 years of experience
in veterinary radiation oncology, she leads every aspect of radiation therapy planning and delivery — bringing advanced technology, clinical precision, and a genuinely individualized approach to each case.
Dr. DiBernardi is
board-certified in Radiation Oncology (DACVR-RO)
, the specialized veterinary credential dedicated to radiation therapy. She also holds board certification in
Medical Oncology (DACVIM)
, providing an added depth of expertise in cancer biology and treatment. This dual-specialty perspective supports comprehensive treatment planning and close collaboration with referring primary veterinarians and veterinary specialists throughout Florida.
Her career has spanned
specialty referral hospitals
and collaborative work with
zoological and wildlife organizations
, building the broad clinical perspective she brings to every patient today. At AARADONC, radiation oncology is not one service among many — it is the sole focus of the entire center.
Pet families and referring veterinarians throughout Palm Beach County and across Florida choose Dr. DiBernardi for her expertise, her clear communication, and her commitment to building individualized treatment plans that prioritize both tumor control and quality of life.

Clinical Philosophy
“Cancer treatment should never be
one-size-fits-all.
Each radiation therapy plan is carefully designed around the specific diagnosis, the patient's condition, and the goals of the family.”
Dr. Lisa DiBernardi, DACVR-RO · AARADONC · Royal Palm Beach, Florida
Precision-first
Every radiation therapy plan is built with 3D CT-based simulation and individual dosimetry — delivering a targeted dose to the tumor while protecting surrounding healthy tissue.
Patient & family centered
Dr. DiBernardi takes time with every family to explain the treatment plan clearly, answer all questions, and ensure pet families feel informed and confident — at every step of the process.
Collaborative by design
Radiation oncology is most effective when integrated into a coordinated care team. Dr. DiBernardi works closely with referring primary veterinarians and specialists throughout Florida to develop individualized, evidence-based treatment plans. Your veterinary team remains at the center of your pet's care, while we provide specialized radiation oncology expertise as a dedicated partner.
